_doc: Steve 2026-10-15: combat must not be the only viable route to good gear. These are starting levers, measured in gear-usage audits. No passive day/wave unlock for broadcast mastery or trade; food-powered gifts never replace dinner.
_lootRoutes: Lootabilities Arm 1 (2026-10-31; corrected same day): every lootTier item in items.json belongs to at least one named earnable route. extraItems = the PRIZE pool (contest prizes, broadcast gifts, trade; consulted by rollAlienLoot on rewardSource paths and by alienPlayers gift grants) - EQUIPMENT ONLY (armor/weapon fields), per the noncombat-rewards invariant: a prize addition must be real gear. killItems = the KILL pool membership beyond alien origin: what a carcass can plausibly carry (worn armor, trophies, ammunition, charms, beast-touched gear), consulted by rollAlienLoot on monster kills. The two tier-1 pieces (shard_spear, apology_padding) are kill-pool only: no alien origin, so fan gifts (apWackyGift - curios by canon) never hand them out. Human-story artifacts (ledgers, seals, accord texts) are RUIN finds in regions.json scavenge pools; the ruin search grants any scavenge entry whose id is a real items.json def as that item. Crafting carries the rest. Reference scan (scripts/proof-lootabilities-w1.js scan): 0 unreachable lootTier items.
